chapters.title: Consider Your Ways
chapters.synopsis: The Lord asks through Haggai whether it is time for the people to dwell in their own ceiled houses while his house lies waste, and calls them to consider their ways, for they have sown much and brought in little because the temple remains unbuilt. The people obey the Lord's voice, and he stirs up their spirit to come and work on the house.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Is it time to dwell in ceiled houses while my house waits?

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Consider your ways: sown much, brought in little

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The people obey; the Lord stirs them to build

chapters.title: The Latter Glory of This House
chapters.synopsis: The Lord encourages the discouraged builders to be strong, for his spirit remains among them, and promises that the latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former. Through questions to the priests about holiness and defilement, the Lord promises blessing from that day forward, and declares that he will yet shake the heavens and earth and overthrow kingdoms, honoring his servant as a signet.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Be strong; the latter glory shall exceed the former

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Holiness and defilement; from this day I will bless you

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord will shake nations and honor his servant
